title: Installment Plan
raw_text:
9/29/26, 10:15 AM

Functions only with Change                            Calling the function

Deactivate installment plan                           Installment Plan >» Deactivate
Installment Plan

Add installment                                           Edit » Add Installment

Delete installment                                        Select the appropriate installment(s) and
choose |+Edit Delete Installment

Display source receivables in the                      Goto » Display Source Receivables for
installment plan history                             Installment Plan

Procedure / Notes

If the installment plan has not yet been paid
or has been partially paid, an automatic

reversal of the interest and the charge
document for this installment plan is

possible.

If you add or delete installments, you must
then ensure that the total of the installment

plan corresponds to the amount of the
source receivable.

If you add or delete installments, you must
then ensure that the total of the installment
plan corresponds to the amount of the
source receivable.

This brings you to the installment plan
history. It will tell you which receivables are
included in the installment plan. This

function is also possible after the
reactivation of the installment plan.
